notes.title: V1.2.1 - A juicy, gassy update
notes.content:
[h1]The update you've all been waiting for![/h1]

[b]Farty Party[/b] can now be launched as a standalone game 😁 no need to load an appropriate save game, just launch the game from the Steam client and choose the option*.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239058/4f7bd417b7b7027fa35f1742b68d9b84ee440d1c.png[/img]

But wait, there's more!
[h2]Weekly and monthly leaderboards[/h2]
Are you tired of not being able to reach the top 6? We just introduced timed leaderboards that you can check on the standalone mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239058/b20a5a9b3704996f8331bb545c28bfe1b4aa7e50.png[/img]

And stay tuned, because there will be even more in the future...

*[i]alternatively you can launch the TWoAF executable via command line by passing [b]fpstandalone[/b] as parameter[/i]
